findings.reason: the node's negative control goes green while the instruction it exists to retire survives in the file a coordinator loads first, so the queue-first pattern is never fully in force.
findings.text: §13 asserts "The mechanism is unused until the skills teach it" and its done-when requires that "a grep of the skills finds no remaining instruction to dispatch section by section on every beat", but the identical instruction also lives outside `skills/`, in the repository's own `AGENTS.md:31` ("an idle lane with ready work is a defect — dispatch every ready-idle section each beat"), which a coordinator reads every session; a grep scoped to the skills passes while the coordinator is still told to dispatch ready-idle sections each beat

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `queue_requests` (§9) exists in the authored batch entry at `reckon/crew/queue_admission.py` in §2's landing commit; `PlanReviewMissingError` is raised in `reckon/crew/routing.py:2450,2547`; `crew stop` at `reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1961`; `crew view drain` at `reckon/crew/runs.py:1789`; `parse_plan_ref` at `reckon/_schema.py:276`; `_priority_key` at `reckon/roadmap_ranking.py:196`; `_store_brief` at `reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:2241`; `STARVATION_AGE_SECONDS = 30 * 60` at `reckon/crew/queue_order.py:13`; `ADMISSION_VERDICT_LOG = "admission-verdicts.jsonl"` at `reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:60`; the `scopes` view at `reckon/mcp_views.py:3687`; the three skill files exist; every cited plan href resolves (`<slug>.html`).
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — s13's negative control greps "the skills" only, so it never sees the same instruction in the repository's own `AGENTS.md:31`.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §14's evidence is `docs/evidence/archive/a-queue-holds-the-whole-plan-landed.html`, a durable in-repo path; §2's logs sit under the run directory; no node writes to a session scratchpad or a node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags reach any symbol the changed sections introduce (`awaiting-upstream`, `blocked-upstream`, `held`, `queue_requests` are mechanism names).
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §11's mechanism runs on the real gate path: the plan-review gate measures change per unit and carries a `_document` unit (`reckon/crew/plan_review.py:87`, `_uncovered_change_detail` in `reckon/crew/routing.py`), which is exactly the unit set §11 limits the gate to; §8 names `queue_requests` (§2's batch entry, unmerged at this base, as §9 says) and §9 supplies the production caller; §12's verdict detail is recorded per queued request with `run_id` and `verdict` by `_verdict_row` (`reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:864`), so the instrument §12 reads can answer it.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each of s8–s14 carries one deliverable (s8 graph waits, s9 batch enqueue, s10 hold/release, s11 edit safety, s12 drain view, s13 skills; s14 is the single dogfood measure).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the new sections' `plan-section-depends-on` edges are acyclic and each section that reads a state another section defines waits on it (§2 → §5 → §4 → §3 → §9 → §13 → §14; §10 → §11, §12), and s14's cross-project ref `imas-ambix:local-lane-admission-control#s27` resolves to a real section ("The router publishes the lane's worker slots, and reckon divides them").
